content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"That was Mara Ibarra, known on Forge as Mara, login mara-river, account ID 1847.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Her proposal appears in HarborMesh issue 47: https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh/issues/47.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"She posted comment c901 on 2026-04-12; our code body received the issue record through Forge on 2026-04-14.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"She suggested a local replay queue to preserve relay readings through outages while keeping the existing scheduler.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"Mara and our code body agreed to prototype it on 2026-04-14.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Our 2026-04-16 project memory recorded an active prototype at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh, with docs/STATUS.md as the current-state entry point.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"A human report received through our code body on 2026-05-03 said the April 30 trial replayed buffered readings correctly through an outage.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"That report said wider rollout was paused on May 2 pending understanding of calibration drift, with no production deployment yet.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not establish the project's present deployment status.","support":[2],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"}]}
